Estimate treatment effects at a patient's baseline risk

Source: R/predict.R
estimate_treatment_effect.Rd

Returns the pooled treatment effects of an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor (ARPI) plus ADT versus placebo plus ADT at each patient's baseline risk. The effects were estimated within each of 4 randomized clinical trials as smooth functions of baseline risk and pooled with multivariate random-effects meta-analysis.

Usage

estimate_treatment_effect(
  newdata,
  scale = c("ard", "rmst", "hr"),
  model = mhspc_model()
)

Arguments

newdata

A data frame with one row per patient and one column per input listed by model_inputs(): ecog_ps (0, 1, or 2), gleason_score (2 to 10), visceral_metastasis (0 or 1, or logical), bone_metastases (a count, or a category code "0-3", "4-6", "7-10", or "11+"), psa (ng/mL), hemoglobin (g/L), albumin (g/L), alp (U/L), and ldh (U/L). Other columns are ignored.

scale

Effects to return: "ard", the difference in the probability of being alive at 4 years; "rmst", the difference in restricted mean survival time through 4 years, in months; "hr", the hazard ratio for death.

model

An mhspc_model object from mhspc_model().

Value

A data frame with one row per patient and scale: row, baseline_risk, scale, estimate, the 95% confidence interval (conf_low, conf_high), the 95% prediction interval for a new trial population (pred_low, pred_high), in_effect_range, and notes.

Details

Positive absolute effects indicate gains with an ARPI. For baseline risks outside the range in which effects were estimated, the effect at the nearest edge of that range is returned and in_effect_range is FALSE.

Examples

patient <- data.frame(
  ecog_ps = 0, gleason_score = 9, visceral_metastasis = 0,
  bone_metastases = 8, psa = 45, hemoglobin = 128, albumin = 41,
  alp = 180, ldh = 210
)
estimate_treatment_effect(patient)
#>   row baseline_risk scale  estimate  conf_low conf_high   pred_low pred_high
#> 1   1     0.6160547   ard 0.1564764 0.1044090 0.2085438 0.04217641 0.2707764
#> 2   1     0.6160547  rmst 5.0448804 3.5714697 6.5182911 1.74810649 8.3416542
#> 3   1     0.6160547    hr 0.6037809 0.5201066 0.7009167 0.42913587 0.8495010
#>   in_effect_range notes
#> 1            TRUE  <NA>
#> 2            TRUE  <NA>
#> 3            TRUE  <NA>
